name: Actor-Critic Methods
learningObjectives: Understand the actor-critic architecture with separate policy and value networks
Learn how the critic reduces variance in policy gradient methods
Understand the advantage function and temporal difference learning in actor-critic
Explore the balance between bias and variance in reinforcement learning
Implement online learning with simultaneous policy and value updates
Visualize policy evolution and value function learning in grid environments

controls.label: Environment
controls.tooltip: Choose a grid-world environment with different obstacles and rewards

controls.label: Actor Learning Rate
controls.tooltip: Learning rate for the policy network (actor). Lower values provide more stable policy updates.

controls.label: Critic Learning Rate
controls.tooltip: Learning rate for the value network (critic). Often higher than actor learning rate for faster value learning.

controls.label: Discount Factor (γ)
controls.tooltip: How much the agent values future rewards. Higher values make the agent more far-sighted.

controls.label: Entropy Coefficient
controls.tooltip: Entropy bonus for exploration. Higher values encourage more exploration by penalizing deterministic policies.

controls.label: Training Episodes
controls.tooltip: Number of episodes to train the agent. More episodes allow better learning but take longer.

controls.label: Max Steps per Episode
controls.tooltip: Maximum number of steps allowed in each episode before timeout.

visualizations.title: Reward per Episode
visualizations.description: Line chart showing total reward accumulated in each training episode

visualizations.title: Steps per Episode
visualizations.description: Line chart showing number of steps taken to reach the goal in each episode

visualizations.title: Actor and Critic Loss
visualizations.description: Line chart showing the evolution of actor (policy) and critic (value) losses during training

visualizations.title: State Values (Critic)
visualizations.description: Heatmap showing the learned state values from the critic network

visualizations.title: Policy Visualization
visualizations.description: Visualization showing the learned policy (action probabilities) for each state

visualizations.title: Environment with Optimal Path
visualizations.description: Grid visualization showing the environment, obstacles, and the learned optimal path

metrics.name: Average Reward (Last 10 Episodes)
metrics.description: Mean total reward over the last 10 training episodes

metrics.name: Average Steps (Last 10 Episodes)
metrics.description: Mean number of steps to reach goal over the last 10 episodes

metrics.name: Optimal Path Length
metrics.description: Number of steps in the learned optimal path from start to goal

metrics.name: Success Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of last 10 episodes where the agent reached the goal

metrics.name: Total Episodes
metrics.description: Total number of training episodes completed

metrics.name: Average Actor Loss
metrics.description: Mean actor (policy) loss over the last 10 episodes

metrics.name: Average Critic Loss
metrics.description: Mean critic (value) loss over the last 10 episodes

metrics.name: Entropy Coefficient
metrics.description: Current entropy coefficient used for exploration
